lines.zh: 三格多高，每一步都压塌草。
lines.en: Three blocks tall, and every step flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，树要低头。
lines.en: Where I walk, the trees have to bow.

lines.zh: 尾尖扫过地面，划出一道沟。
lines.en: My tail tip sweeps the ground and cuts a furrow.

lines.zh: 长腿迈开，声音比雷慢半拍。
lines.en: My long legs open up, a beat slower than thunder.

lines.zh: 我体重压得石头裂成两块。
lines.en: My weight splits the stone in two.

lines.zh: 一步抵你三步，不必着急。
lines.en: One of my steps is three of yours; no hurry.

lines.zh: 巨蜥的步子，从来不看脚下。
lines.en: A great lizard never looks down at its feet.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪陷进湿泥里。
lines.en: My claws sink into the wet mud.

lines.zh: 走动时，鳞片互相摩擦作响。
lines.en: As I move, my scales scrape and rasp.

lines.zh: 这条路上，只有我的脚印。
lines.en: On this road, there are only my footprints.

lines.zh: 我站着，比两棵树叠起来还高。
lines.en: Standing, I am taller than two trees stacked.

lines.zh: 风从我的背脊上滑下去。
lines.en: The wind slides down the ridge of my back.

lines.zh: 我的下巴离地三格多。
lines.en: My jaw hangs more than three blocks above the ground.

lines.zh: 鳞甲十五点，晒得发烫。
lines.en: Fifteen points of scales, hot from the sun.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，用舌头听世界。
lines.en: I close my eyes and listen with my tongue.

lines.zh: 三百年没变的，是我的胃口。
lines.en: The one thing unchanged in three centuries is my appetite.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻敲着地面，像打拍。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground, keeping time.

lines.zh: 我在等风带来猎物的味道。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to bring me prey scent.

lines.zh: 这具身躯太大，转身很费劲。
lines.en: This body is too big; turning is hard work.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我背上，我懒得动。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my back; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我咬合了一下牙齿，试了试。
lines.en: I bite down once, just to test my teeth.

lines.zh: 大也有大的麻烦，比如痒。
lines.en: Being huge has drawbacks, like itching.

lines.zh: 我的影子足够盖住一棵树。
lines.en: My shadow is wide enough to cover a tree.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地咽了口唾沫。
lines.en: I swallow slowly, once.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让太阳晒另一面鳞。
lines.en: I turn so the sun can reach the other side of my scales.

lines.zh: 脚底下这块石头，被我踩裂了。
lines.en: The stone under my feet has cracked from my weight.

lines.zh: 你在我脚下，像一块活动的石子。
lines.en: You are a moving pebble beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我低下头，颈骨发出长响。
lines.en: I lower my head and my neck bones groan.

lines.zh: 你站的这块地，我踩平过。
lines.en: I've flattened the ground you stand on.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两侧，全都看得见。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides; I see it all.

lines.zh: 抬头太难，我干脆俯视你。
lines.en: Looking up is hard, so I look down at you.

lines.zh: 你举着剑，剑尖在抖。
lines.en: You raise your sword, and the tip is trembling.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，睫毛比你的手指长。
lines.en: I blink; my lashes are longer than your fingers.

lines.zh: 你这点个头，我一口就没了。
lines.en: A thing your size disappears in one bite.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，想着从哪开始咬。
lines.en: I stare at you, deciding where to bite first.

lines.zh: 你的汗味混着铁，飘到我鼻尖。
lines.en: Your sweat and iron drift up to my snout.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，露出侧面的牙。
lines.en: I tilt my head and show the teeth along my jaw.

lines.zh: 别仰头，看不清就别看。
lines.en: Do not crane your neck; if you cannot see, do not look.

lines.zh: 你划破了我的鳞，很浅。
lines.en: You cut my scales, and shallowly at that.

lines.zh: 这点伤，只够让我转身。
lines.en: This wound is only enough to make me turn.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，树叶落了一层。
lines.en: I roared once and a layer of leaves fell.

lines.zh: 我不退，只是换了个角度。
lines.en: I do not retreat; I change my angle.

lines.zh: 疼痛让我更想吃你。
lines.en: Pain makes me want to eat you more.

lines.zh: 你会看见伤口自己合上。
lines.en: You will watch the wound close itself.

lines.zh: 这一击，你用了全部力气吧。
lines.en: You put everything into that blow, did you not?

lines.zh: 我的尾巴烦躁地拍了两下。
lines.en: My tail slaps the ground twice in irritation.

lines.zh: 别停手，我还没尽兴。
lines.en: Do not stop; I am not finished enjoying this.

lines.zh: 鳞甲十五点，你的剑不够硬。
lines.en: Fifteen points of scales, and your blade is not hard enough.

lines.zh: 我不吃递过来的东西，我自己取。
lines.en: I do not take offered food; I take it myself.

lines.zh: 你手上的肉太小，不够塞牙。
lines.en: The meat in your hands is too small to wedge in my teeth.

lines.zh: 巨蜥只对会跑的食物有兴趣。
lines.en: A great lizard only cares for food that runs.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，够不到我的嘴。
lines.en: Hold it higher; it still will not reach my mouth.

lines.zh: 我不接受投喂，只接受逃跑。
lines.en: I accept no handouts, only flight.

lines.zh: 那点分量，连舌头都碰不到。
lines.en: That much would not even touch my tongue.

lines.zh: 食物留下，人也可以留下。
lines.en: Leave the food, and you may leave as well.

lines.zh: 那块肉太小，你的气味更大。
lines.en: The meat is small; your scent is much larger.

lines.zh: 别拿谷子来试，我不吃素。
lines.en: Do not try grain on me; I am no plant eater.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，不理你的手。
lines.en: When I am hungry, I pay your hands no mind.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞一棵会咬的树。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a tree that bites.

lines.zh: 我的腿比你的腰粗。
lines.en: My leg is thicker than your waist.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，你就得让开。
lines.en: When I lift a foot, you move.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你被推得滑了出去。
lines.en: That bump slid you across the ground.

lines.zh: 十五点鳞甲滑得像磨过的石头。
lines.en: Fifteen points of scales, slick as polished stone.

lines.zh: 我侧了一下身，地就空了。
lines.en: I shifted sideways and the ground was empty.

lines.zh: 别站我脚边，那是不长眼的位置。
lines.en: Do not stand by my foot; that is a blind spot.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴不经意扫到了你。
lines.en: My tail swept you aside without meaning to.

lines.zh: 你退得很快，还算懂事。
lines.en: You backed off quickly, which shows sense.

lines.zh: 三格多高的墙，你敢贴上来。
lines.en: A wall three blocks tall, and you leaned on it.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣要跟我一样高。
lines.en: My mate would have to stand as tall as I do.

lines.zh: 这岛上，没有第二头这么大的。
lines.en: There is no second creature this size on the island.

lines.zh: 我把巢筑在最高的岩下。
lines.en: I built my nest beneath the highest rock.

lines.zh: 求偶时，我们会互相撞头。
lines.en: When courting, we knock our heads together.

lines.zh: 没有谁愿意和我分一块肉。
lines.en: No one is willing to share a kill with me.

lines.zh: 我独自守着这片领地。
lines.en: I guard this territory alone.

lines.zh: 巨蜥的亲近，是并排晒太阳。
lines.en: A great lizard's affection is sunbathing side by side.

lines.zh: 我把蛋埋进热土，然后离开。
lines.en: I bury the eggs in hot soil and leave.

lines.zh: 你问这些，我只想咬你。
lines.en: Ask me this and I only want to bite you.

lines.zh: 我这一生，只认真看过一个影子。
lines.en: In my life I have studied only one shadow closely.

lines.zh: 我的爪有三趾，捏不住一枚代币。
lines.en: Three toes cannot pinch a single gold token.

lines.zh: 地上闪光的，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: I have no interest in shiny things on the ground.

lines.zh: 我叼起过一头牛，没叼过硬币。
lines.en: I have carried a cow in my jaws, never a coin.

lines.zh: 我低头，只为了闻血。
lines.en: I lower my head only to smell blood.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，被我踩碎了。
lines.en: What you dropped was crushed under my foot.

lines.zh: 牙缝里卡的不是宝贝。
lines.en: What sticks between my teeth is no treasure.

lines.zh: 我的前爪短，够不到地面。
lines.en: My forelegs are short and cannot reach the ground.

lines.zh: 捡东西这种活，交给小兽。
lines.en: Picking things up is a job for small beasts.

lines.zh: 战利品？我只留骨头在山坡。
lines.en: Spoils? I leave only bones on the hillside.

lines.zh: 地上的铁片，硌了我一脚。
lines.en: A scrap of iron on the ground stung my foot.

lines.zh: 六十四格内，你的热度很显眼。
lines.en: Within sixty-four blocks, your warmth stands out.

lines.zh: 我转过头，脖子响了一长声。
lines.en: I turn my head and my neck rattles long and loud.

lines.zh: 你进入视野，我就不再吃草。
lines.en: Once you are in sight, I stop grazing.

lines.zh: 目标：一个会跑的小东西。
lines.en: Target: one small thing that runs.

lines.zh: 我低下头，鼻尖对着你。
lines.en: I lower my head and point my snout at you.

lines.zh: 这一片是我的地盘，你越界了。
lines.en: This stretch is mine, and you crossed the line.

lines.zh: 锁定你，只用了半次呼吸。
lines.en: Locking onto you took half a breath.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔缩了一下。
lines.en: My pupils narrowed once.

lines.zh: 你站着的姿势，像在邀请我。
lines.en: The way you stand looks like an invitation.

lines.zh: 巨蜥的规矩很简单：先追。
lines.en: A great lizard's rule is simple: chase first.

lines.zh: 我要把你从这块地上抹掉。
lines.en: I will wipe you off this piece of ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，准备起跑。
lines.en: I raise a foreleg, ready to run.

lines.zh: 六十四格，我三步就到。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks, and I need three strides.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，把我叫过来了。
lines.en: The heat of you is what called me over.

lines.zh: 你从坡上下来，影子先碰到我。
lines.en: You come down the slope, and your shadow reaches me first.

lines.zh: 我闻到汗味，那不是草的味道。
lines.en: I smell sweat, and that is not the smell of grass.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，把眼睛对准你。
lines.en: I lower my neck and line my eye up with you.

lines.zh: 我已经决定了，你正好在。
lines.en: I have already decided, and there you are.

lines.zh: 你跑得快，我的步幅更大。
lines.en: You run fast, but my stride is longer.

lines.zh: 我一步，你三步，差距还在。
lines.en: One of mine, three of yours, and the gap remains.

lines.zh: 击退我？先推得动这身鳞甲。
lines.en: Knock me back? First move these scales.

lines.zh: 树挡在中间，我就撞开它。
lines.en: If a tree stands between us, I knock it aside.

lines.zh: 我追得不急，猎物总会累。
lines.en: I do not hurry; prey always tires.

lines.zh: 你的味道留在每一片叶子上。
lines.en: Your scent is left on every leaf.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我转向比你快。
lines.en: One swing of my tail and I turn faster than you.

lines.zh: 我不会喘，这具身躯太耐用。
lines.en: I do not pant; this body is built to last.

lines.zh: 六十四格，对我来说是近处。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks is close range for me.

lines.zh: 你听见脚爪声了吗？就在后面。
lines.en: Do you hear the claws? They are right behind you.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印追。
lines.en: I follow by stepping in your prints.

lines.zh: 别爬树，树也撑不住我。
lines.en: Do not climb; the tree cannot hold me anyway.

lines.zh: 你越绕，我越想吃。
lines.en: The more you circle, the hungrier I get.

lines.zh: 我从不半途停下。
lines.en: I never stop halfway.

lines.zh: 你往石堆里钻，石头挡不住我。
lines.en: You duck into the rocks, but rocks do not stop me.

lines.zh: 我每落地一次，地就震一下。
lines.en: Every step I land shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就在你身后十格。
lines.en: Look back: I am ten blocks behind you.

lines.zh: 我咬断挡路的树枝，继续走。
lines.en: I bite through a branch in my way and keep walking.

lines.zh: 你跑向河边，水也拦不住我。
lines.en: You run for the river, but water will not save you.

lines.zh: 我不换方向，你总会撞上我。
lines.en: I never change course; sooner or later you meet me.

lines.zh: 三十点，一口就能结束。
lines.en: Thirty points, and one bite ends it.

lines.zh: 我的牙落下去，骨头会碎。
lines.en: When my teeth come down, bone breaks.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我把盾连人掀翻。
lines.en: You raise a shield, and I flip shield and man together.

lines.zh: 这一咬，带走了你半块护甲。
lines.en: That bite took half your armor with it.

lines.zh: 巨蜥不撕扯，直接碾。
lines.en: A great lizard does not tear; it crushes.

lines.zh: 我的前爪按住你，然后低头。
lines.en: My foreleg pins you, then my head comes down.

lines.zh: 血喷在鳞片上，很快滑落。
lines.en: Blood sprays my scales and slides right off.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞断了一棵小树。
lines.en: You flew and snapped a young tree in half.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把你扔开。
lines.en: I shook my head and threw you off.

lines.zh: 三十点近战，一口不重不漏。
lines.en: Thirty points of melee, one bite, nothing wasted.

lines.zh: 你还在动，我再补一下。
lines.en: You are still moving, so I add one more.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里留了你的味道。
lines.en: Your taste is stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一记，我等你很久了。
lines.en: I have waited a long time for that one.

lines.zh: 巨蜥的耐心，只用在下口前。
lines.en: A great lizard's patience ends the moment it bites.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里站起，高过周围的树。
lines.en: I rise from a rock cleft, taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 三格多的骨架顶开了天。
lines.en: Three blocks of body push against the open sky.

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面沉了一下。
lines.en: When I land, the ground gives a little.

lines.zh: 尘土扬起，又落回我的背上。
lines.en: Dust rises, then settles back on my back.

lines.zh: 这片地有新主人了。
lines.en: This land has a new master.

lines.zh: 六十四格内，风都变慢了。
lines.en: Within sixty-four blocks, even the wind slows.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙里滚出一声闷响。
lines.en: I raise my head and a low growl rolls out.

lines.zh: 巨蜥现身，从不打招呼。
lines.en: A great lizard never announces itself.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压过来。
lines.en: My shadow presses in first.

lines.zh: 猎场空了，只剩我的脚印。
lines.en: The hunting ground empties, leaving only my prints.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸直，向你宣告。
lines.en: I stretch my neck straight to make my claim.

lines.zh: 三百年的等待，值这一战。
lines.en: Three hundred years of waiting was worth this fight.

lines.zh: 这片草被我压平了一半。
lines.en: I flattened half this field of grass.

lines.zh: 你听见的第一声，是我的呼吸。
lines.en: The first thing you hear is my breathing.

lines.zh: 我从地底撑起身体，土往下滑。
lines.en: I push myself up out of the ground and the soil slides off.

lines.zh: 这一带安静太久，我来了。
lines.en: This land has been quiet too long; I am here.

lines.zh: 我甩掉背上的碎石，站直。
lines.en: I shake the rubble off my back and stand tall.

lines.zh: 第一声脚步，就是我给的信。
lines.en: My first footstep is the only notice you get.

lines.zh: 巨蜥从峡谷里走上来，风停了。
lines.en: The lizard walks up from the ravine, and the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我张开口，把热气吐在空气里。
lines.en: I open my jaws and breathe hot air into the sky.

lines.zh: 火舔过我的鳞，我讨厌这味道。
lines.en: Fire licks my scales and I hate the smell.

lines.zh: 我落地时砸出一圈坑。
lines.en: I hit the ground and left a ring of craters.

lines.zh: 水只到我的胸口，凉快。
lines.en: The water only reaches my chest, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得侧了半步。
lines.en: The blast pushed me half a step sideways.

lines.zh: 箭叮在鳞上，掉了一地。
lines.en: Arrows ping off my scales and fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的骨头一阵发酸。
lines.en: Magic leaves my bones aching and sour.

lines.zh: 我饿，但先吃完你再说。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I will finish you first.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，鳞片发亮。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and my scales lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空咬我，我用爪子扒住岩边。
lines.en: The void bites me; my claws dig into the ledge.
